tha-ap202:1.1: Yūthikapupphiya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / pavanā nikkhamitvāna vihāraṃ yāti cakkhumā. // //
tha-ap202:2.1: Ubho hatthehi paggayha yūthikaṃ puppham uttamaṃ / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ mettacittassa tādino. // //
tha-ap202:3.1: Tena cittappasādena anubhotvāna sampadā / kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap202:4.1: Ito paññāsakappesu eko āsi janādhipo / Samitaṃnandano nāma cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap202:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Yūthikapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap202:9.1: Khaṇḍaphullī-Asokiyo Aṅkoḷakī Kisalayo Tinduko Nelapupphiyo Tikaṇḍo Yūthiko gāthāyo paññāsañ ca aṭṭhañ ca. Tamālapupphiyavaggo vīsatimo.
tha-ap202:11.1: Bhikkhado Parivāro ca Sereyya-Sobhito tathā Chatto ca Bandhujīvī ca Supāricariyo pi ca.
tha-ap202:12.1: Kumudo Kuṭajo ceva Tamālika dasamo kato chassatāni ca gāthānaṃ chasaṭṭhi ca tatuttariṃ.
